module arbiter #(
    parameter PORTS = 4,
    parameter ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK = 0,
    parameter ARB_BLOCK_ACK = 1,
    parameter ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] request,
    input wire [PORTS-1:0] acknowledge,
    output wire [PORTS-1:0] grant,
    output wire grant_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded
);

localparam ENC_WIDTH = PORTS > 1 ? $clog2(PORTS) : 2;
reg [PORTS-1:0] grant_reg, grant_next;
reg grant_valid_reg, grant_valid_next;
reg [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] grant_encoded_reg, grant_encoded_next;
reg [PORTS-1:0] mask_reg, mask_next;

assign grant = grant_reg;
assign grant_valid = grant_valid_reg;
assign grant_encoded = grant_encoded_reg;

wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request = request & mask_reg;
wire request_valid = |request;
wire masked_request_valid = |masked_request;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_higher;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_higher;
wire [PORTS-1:0] request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] masked_request_winner;

genvar i, b;
generate
    for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i + 1) begin : priority_terms
        if (ARB_LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            if (i == 0) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign request_higher[i] = |request[i-1:0];
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = |masked_request[i-1:0];
            end
        end else begin : msb
            if (i == PORTS-1) begin : edge_bit
                assign request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = 1'b0;
            end else begin : other_bits
                assign request_higher[i] = |request[PORTS-1:i+1];
                assign masked_request_higher[i] = |masked_request[PORTS-1:i+1];
            end
        end
        assign request_winner[i] = request[i] & ~request_higher[i];
        assign masked_request_winner[i] = masked_request[i] & ~masked_request_higher[i];
    end
endgenerate

wire use_masked = ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && masked_request_valid;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_winner = use_masked ? masked_request_winner : request_winner;
wire [PORTS-1:0] selected_mask = use_masked ? masked_request_higher : request_higher;
wire [$clog2(PORTS)-1:0] selected_index;

generate
    for (b = 0; b < ENC_WIDTH; b = b + 1) begin : encode_bits
        wire [PORTS-1:0] terms;
        for (i = 0; i < PORTS; i = i + 1) begin : encode_terms
            if ((i >> b) & 1) begin : included
                assign terms[i] = selected_winner[i];
            end else begin : excluded
                assign terms[i] = 1'b0;
            end
        end
        assign selected_index[b] = |terms;
    end
endgenerate

wire hold_grant = (ARB_BLOCK && !ARB_BLOCK_ACK && (|(grant_reg & request))) ||
                  (ARB_BLOCK && ARB_BLOCK_ACK && grant_valid_reg && !(|(grant_reg & acknowledge)));

always @* begin
    grant_next = selected_winner;
    grant_valid_next = request_valid;
    grant_encoded_next = selected_index;
    mask_next = mask_reg;

    if (ARB_TYPE_ROUND_ROBIN && request_valid && !hold_grant)
        mask_next = selected_mask;

    if (hold_grant) begin
        grant_next = grant_reg;
        grant_valid_next = grant_valid_reg;
        grant_encoded_next = grant_encoded_reg;
    end
end

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (rst) begin
        grant_reg <= 0;
        grant_valid_reg <= 0;
        grant_encoded_reg <= 0;
        mask_reg <= 0;
    end else begin
        grant_reg <= grant_next;
        grant_valid_reg <= grant_valid_next;
        grant_encoded_reg <= grant_encoded_next;
        mask_reg <= mask_next;
    end
end
endmodule

/* Original standalone helper interface and behavior retained. */
module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);
parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;
wire [W-1:0] input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid[LEVELS-1:0];
wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc[LEVELS-1:0];
genvar l, n;
generate
    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end
    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ? {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]} : {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] = stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ? {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} : {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:n*2*l]};
            end
        end
    end
endgenerate
assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original datapath computes priority indices, decodes them back into one-hot grants, and performs variable shifts to update the round-robin mask. These operations, together with masked/unmasked selection and blocking feedback, create avoidable serial logic. The supplied STA paths show deep register-to-register logic, although their mapped names do not identify precise RTL endpoints.",
  "rewrite": "Compute raw and masked one-hot winners directly from parallel higher-priority request reductions. Reuse those same reductions as the next round-robin mask: a mask bit is set exactly when a higher-priority request exists. Select the raw or masked winner and encode it with parallel OR reductions. Retain grant_reg, grant_valid_reg, grant_encoded_reg, mask_reg, their next-state signals, and synchronous reset.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve setup WNS by removing encoded-index decoding and variable-shift mask generation from the state-feedback datapath. The principal remaining paths are priority reduction, candidate selection, encoding or blocking selection, and register setup. No numerical gain is claimed without synthesis and STA.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Eliminates both variable mask shifters and grant decoders, while adding explicitly parallel priority reductions and OR encoding. Area is expected to decrease, but reduction sharing, buffering, electrical checks, and compliance with the 4855.656960 um2 cap require measurement with the specified flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves registered output latency, synchronous reset, blocking-on-request and blocking-on-acknowledge behavior, both priority directions, fixed-priority and round-robin modes, wraparound, and zero outputs when idle and not blocked. Mask state is retained while blocked or idle. No initialization, additional state, startup assumptions, or restrictions on later requests, acknowledgements, or resets are introduced. The next-state transformation is valid for arbitrary defined existing register values; the original standalone priority_encoder helper is also included unchanged in behavior. Formal equivalence and mapped timing/electrical validation remain to be run."
}
